Character sprites (char_01.png .. char_10.png) are individual 16x16px tiles
cropped from Kenney's "RPG Urban Pack" (https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-urban-pack).

Room/furniture tiles (floor_stone_grey, floor_stone_cream, rug_teal, rug_orange,
rug_purple, rug_cyan, desk_1, desk_2, desk_corner, chair, bookshelf, cabinet,
plant, plant_flower, painting, door_arch) are individual 16x16px tiles cropped
from Kenney's "Roguelike/RPG Pack" (https://kenney.nl/assets/roguelike-rpg-pack).
